Silent — Act 3 boss 2-card combo effectiveness (A9, A10)

n (with) = observations (one per Act 3 boss fight -- one below ascension 10, two at ascension 10+, fought independently) where the run owned BOTH cards by the time of the fight; "without" is everyone else (owns just one, or neither) -- not a true synergy test, see the homepage methodology. Diff (HP saved) = avg without minus avg with; positive means the pair correlates with less damage. Use the boss selector to switch between a single boss and the 4-boss combined ranking (both server-computed, not re-aggregated in the browser). Only pairs with min(n_with, n_without) > 50 are included at all.

Full methodology and caveats: see the 2-card combo effectiveness methodology on the homepage.
